name: Surya Namaskar (one round, jump-back variant)
licence: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database: free for all uses (no reselling of the data itself)
credit: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
note: One round of an Ashtanga-style sun salutation (jumps back to plank and forward again; low push-up and upward dog). The app teaches the Sivananda round with lunges, so this shows the quality of real motion, not the same sequence.
